provider: nostr relays as a byte store (including base64-in-event tricks)

free_tier.stated: NIP-94 is metadata only, and the relay event size ceiling (~64 KB) caps any inline payload at roughly 48 KB after base64 expansion. Chainable as an index for Blossom, worthless as storage.
